channel.title: Wire — Security
channel.description: Security from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: GitLab Warns That AI Agent Sandboxes Are Only as Secure as Their Network Access
item.description: GitLab warns that isolating an AI coding agent in a sandbox does not necessarily make the agent safe. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Does ICANN Open the Door on Identity Theft by Dropping 3rd Level .name Domains Registrations?
item.description: Neil Fraser's disclosure highlights a regulatory change affecting the .name top-level domain. Following ICANN's approval, Verisign will eliminate third-level registrations due to declining usage. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: We have a year to fix security everywhere
item.description: consumer-grade hardware can run an LLM that hacks the planet. we can stop it, but we don't have much time. (1 source: hackernews)
